name: mythic-forge
description: Mythic Forge — a lightweight, cross-platform game & 3D creation engine by Mythic Bharat Studios.
author: Mythic Bharat Studios

scripts.build: npm run audit:licenses && npm run notices && npm run build -w @mythic-forge/editor
scripts.build:app: npm run audit:licenses && npm run notices && npm run build:app -w @mythic-forge/editor
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run audit:licenses
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:app && npm run sync -w @mythic-forge/android
